text:
maya: Heads up — I want to kick off a very low-noise canary for enterprise customer 'Quantica' on dedicated-pool-3. Goal: 0.5% steady traffic for 30m, strict isolation so we don't contaminate shared caches. No UX announcement.

liam: fine by me. what's the isolation plan? split by tenant id + dedicated KV namespaces? :thinking_face:

maya: exactly. Route keys -> tenant-id. Also pin to pool-3 and enable prefix-KV namespace 'qtc-canary'. Policy: no cross-tenant cache reads, and deny fallback to hosted variants.

jordana: can we add a circuit-breaker that aborts the slice if p95 latency > 1.5x baseline or error rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes? We should also block retrying to other pools.

maya: yes. Proposed rollout block rules:
```yaml
rollout: 
  tenant: Quantica
  traffic_split: 0.005
  duration_minutes: 30
  pool: dedicated-pool-3
  kv_namespace: qtc-canary
  isolation: true
  fallbacks: none
  guards:
    - name: p95_latency
      threshold_multiplier: 1.5
      window_seconds: 180
      action: abort
    - name: error_rate
      threshold_percent: 0.5
      window_seconds: 180
      action: abort
    - name: gpu_memory_high
      threshold_percent: 90
      window_seconds: 120
      action: throttle
```

sam: tiny nit — use 'action: pause' instead of abort so ops can inspect traces before rollback. Also add a hard safety that scales traffic to 0 if GPU mem > 95%.

maya: good call. updated in patch.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated for tenant 'Quantica' on dedicated-pool-3 — slice_id=qc-2025-04-01-01, traffic=0.5% :rocket:

telemetry-bot: Streaming metrics: p50/p95 latency, error_rate, token_cost, kv_hit_rate, gpu_mem_pct to #canary-dashboard-qc. Link: https://console.redwood/canaries/qc-2025-04-01-01 :eyes:

liam: Can we gate the dashboard link inside the canary config so operators get one-click view? Also add a small synthetic prompt set to run every 30s.

jordana: yes to synthetic probes. I recommend 10 prompthits/minute, 3 different prompt archetypes matching Quantica's workload (long-context summarization, short chat, reranking). Add mismatch detector for output distribution shifts.

maya: will add probe config and dashboard panels. Ops action items: monitor synthetic success, p95 multiplier, gpu mem. If any guard trips, system will pause and post to this thread.

sam: also add quota cap: enforce per-tenant QPS limit at canary traffic so we don't accidentally spike backfills. cap=20rps for the slice.

maya: done. final config pushed to staging. initiating quiet launch now.

deploy-bot: Canary slice qc-2025-04-01-01 traffic set to 0.5%. Probes scheduled. Reactions: :white_check_mark:

liam: LGTM. I'll keep a tab on traces for the next 45m.

jordana: I'll stand by to promote to 2% if everything looks healthy after 30m.

maya: thanks team. tagging @oncall in case the guard trips.

telemetry-bot: Alert rule created: alert if any guard action != none. Notify: #eng-oncall, #eng-platform.

sam: one followup — can we make the 'no fallback to hosted variant' behavior opt-in per-tenant rather than global in the rollout API? some customers prefer degraded fallback.

maya: good product note. I'll open a small RFC for per-tenant fallback policy and include it in the rollout API v2. Quick win: add 'fallback_policy: deny' to this canary config.

liam: cool. any other blockers?

maya: none. will post results in 35m.
